reviews.name: Rachel
reviews.comment:
Great villa with an excellent host. We had breakfast brought to the villa each morning, floating breakfast was a lovely touch to our stay. Excellent communication with host, arranged a minibus to the airport for us.
This villa is down a long narrow road which made it difficult for cars however I think the locals are used to it so wasn’t a problem to them. 
The villa had a great set up with everything you could possibly need.

reviews.name: Cedric
reviews.comment: Villa St Lau is beautiful, 100% as described, and Grab drivers can get to the villa. The villa manager is very responsive and can offer scooter rental or take care of your laundry and much more. Very nice experience, I would recommend it 👍

Le gérant de la villa est très réactif et peut proposer la location de scooter ou encore s’occuper de votre linge pour le laver et bien d’autres encore . Expérience très agréable, je recommande 👍
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you, Cedric, we're glad the stay was a lovely one and hope to welcome you back.

reviews.name: Camilla Rosenkrantz
reviews.comment: There were 7 of us staying in this beautiful villa for 3 days. It's very spacious and super cozily decorated. Incredibly beautiful in the evening with all the lights around the villa. The service was excellent, and the villa manager was very nice and helpful.

reviews.hostResponse: Thank you, Camilla, for sharing your experience. We’re glad you had a wonderful stay and hope to see you again one day :)

reviews.name: Prabnek
reviews.comment: Beautiful Villa with amaIng hospitality
reviews.hostResponse: Hi Prabnek, we’re happy you enjoyed the villa and the hospitality. It was a pleasure hosting you.

reviews.name: Pascal
reviews.comment: Our stay at Villa St. Lau was fantastic and very relaxing! Relax by the awesome pool surrounded by palm trees and discover beautiful Ubud and the surrounding area with its fascinating rice terraces - a perfect vacation in Bali for us!
reviews.originalComment: Unser Aufenthalt in der Villa St. Lau war traumhaft und sehr erholsam! Entspannen am genialen Pool umgeben von Palmen und entdecken des wunderschönen Ubud und der Umgebung mit den faszinierenden Reisterrassen - perfekte Ferien in Bali für uns!
reviews.hostResponse: Pascal, your feedback means a lot—thank you! We’re thrilled you enjoyed your stay and would be happy to host you again anytime :)

reviews.name: Omar
reviews.comment: We had a wonderful stay at the villa. It was beautiful, clean, and had everything we needed. The host made our trip very convenient by helping us arrange scooter rentals, laundry service, and breakfast. Everything was smooth and well organized. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to others. Thank you for making our trip so memorable!
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you, Omar, for sharing your experience. We’re glad you had a wonderful stay and hope to see you again one day :)

This place only provide car park for 1 car.
I need to find another park for my other car. Luckily there’s an empty villa near this house so i can park there. Can’t imagine how difficult to park if all the villa are full.
reviews.hostResponse: We really appreciate your kind review, Caroline. It’s great to know you enjoyed your stay with us. Looking forward to welcoming you back in the future :)

reviews.name: Marvin
reviews.comment:
Was a wonderful place to stay, everything clean and nice. The billiard table in the living room invites you to play. The kitchen and living room have no air conditioning but fans are provided. 
Otherwise, very large and beautiful complex. We grilled - worked without problems. 
Only the pool was unfortunately not as clean, a foot broke through on a lounger.
But very nice accommodation - but you definitely need a scooter, as it is a bit in nature (quiet and very nice).
We'd love to come back if we're in the area!
reviews.originalComment:
War eine traumhafte Unterkunft, alles sauber und schön. Der Billiardtisch im Wohnzimmer lädt zum Spielen ein. Küche und Wohnzimmer haben keine Klima- aber Ventilatoren sind vorhanden.
Ansonsten sehr große und wunderschöne Anlage. Wir haben gegrillt- hat ohne Probleme funktioniert.
Einzig der Pool war leider nicht so sauber, bei einer Liege ist ein Fuß durchgebrochen.
Aber sehr schöne Unterkunft- man benötigt aber defintiv einen Roller, da es doch ein Stück in der Natur liegt (ruhig und sehr schön).
Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder wenn wir in der Gegend sind!
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Marvin,
We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed your stay! Our team maintains the pool regularly, but since it’s outdoors, occasional leaves or flowers may be blown in by the wind. We’ve also checked all the villa amenities to ensure everything is ready and in excellent condition for our guests.
Thank you for sharing your feedback—we hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Cindy
reviews.comment: Generally a good stay! Host is really responsive. Road to villa is a bit challenging with tiny road, quite hard to navigate if driving car.
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you for your review, Cindy! We are absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us. We look forward to creating more great moments for you during your next visit.

reviews.name: Leilani
reviews.comment:
Does look like an amazing place
Would be good for people that like separated living areas.
All bedrooms, kitchen/dining and living area are all separated. Wouldn't Recommend if it's raining if you need something in the kitchen or living area as you'll have to go outside to access.
We chose this place to relax in the villa for the 3 nights to swim and chill out but the pool was green on arrival and the next day, so checked out. I did receive a partial refund but did have to ask. 
Access to main road is far, best if you have scooter as road is very narrow but did see a big van use it.
A few warungs along the way to villa. Pepito not far.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Leilani,

reviews.name: Abhi
reviews.comment: Spent only 1 day and it was pretty smooth. Didn’t get much time to enjoy the villa. Its very pretty and has very pretty bathrooms rooms. I wish i had more time to enjoy the villa. Pool table was a bonus.
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Abhi! We are absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us. We look forward to creating more great moments for you during your next visit.

reviews.name: Andreea
reviews.comment:
Our stay at St Lau Villa was absolutely wonderful! The villa looked exactly like the photos beautifully presented, clean, and up to standard in every way. From the very beginning, everything was smooth and welcoming. Our driver, Made, was amazing, he patiently waited for us despite our delayed arrival and made the transfer so easy.
Our villa host, Mike, was truly exceptional. He greeted us warmly around midnight, gave us a full tour of the villa, and made sure we felt completely comfortable. His communication throughout our stay was fantastic, always kind, responsive, and willing to help with anything we needed. It really made a difference having such a caring and attentive host.
The villa itself was a perfect escape from reality. We loved the quiet atmosphere, the stunning surroundings. We can’t thank the team enough for their hospitality and warmth. They made our time in Ubud 10x better, and we’d love to come back again soon!
reviews.hostResponse: Hi Andreea, We’re beyond grateful for your kind words and thrilled that your stay was everything you hoped for. We can’t wait to host you again for another memorable visit!

reviews.name: Yash
reviews.comment: Villa was amazing however we faced so many problems that we could not even tell . When we check in we mentioned that pool was not cleaned , even after that they did not clean the pool for 2 days . At check in hot water was not there . A/c of 2 rooms were not cooling . They repaired it then the A/c started leaking water our entire room was soaking wet even our luggage . Wifi stopped working both the nights . When we informed airbnb about the issue the host points out fake things like they found a smoke inside . Also the villa is so inside and very scary in the night .
reviews.hostResponse: Dear Yash, we’re glad to hear that you enjoyed the villa, and we’re sorry for the inconveniences you encountered during your stay. Although the issues have since been resolved, we’ve issued a refund as a gesture of goodwill. We truly hope to have the opportunity to host you again, and we’re confident we can offer a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

reviews.name: Gareth
reviews.comment:
Location was good, not far from most places in Ubud. The villa itself is nice with plenty of space, great size pool and 3 good size bedrooms with AC. The pool table was a great touch as the family loved this in the evening, nice kitchen with everything that was needed. 
Few down sides to the villa were
-No AC in the living room/pool table room or kitchen. 
-pool loungers were rusty and the cushions worn and discoloured.
-we experienced 2 power outages while there but credit to the staff there were on site promptly to sort the issue out. 
Would stay again as the issues wasn’t anything that impacted on our trip.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Gareth,
Thank you for your feedback. Our team has thoroughly checked and ensured that everything is in excellent working order and condition for our guests' comfort. We truly appreciate your visit and look forward to welcoming you back for an even better stay!

name: Iconic 5BR Cliff Top Villa with 180° Ocean View

reviews.name: Domenic
reviews.comment: The view is truly stunning, the private beach access is lovely, and breakfast at the resort restaurant is convenient and delicious. Unfortunately, numerous shortcomings marred the stay: check-in was delayed (3 p.m. instead of 2 p.m.), there were stains on the bed and sun loungers, the rain shower did not work properly, the oven was unusable, the pool pump had to be activated manually, the water dispenser was hygienically questionable, and the refrigerator was dirty. The main bathroom upstairs flooded. There is no window, just an open recess, which makes it extremely hot. The house looks like it needs renovating. The outdoor wooden floor is outdated, with holes and nails (risk of injury). The villa is located in the middle of a resort. Arrival was confusing, and the manager was not very motivated. No Uber/taxi pick-ups allowed in front of the resort. Not enough coffee capsules (10/day) for the whole group. The cleaning staff were friendly, but had to stay for 3 hours according to the instructions. Unfortunately, the value for money is not right. We cannot recommend the villa.
reviews.originalComment: Die Aussicht ist wirklich grandios, der private Strandzugang schön und das Frühstück im Resort-Restaurant praktisch und lecker. Leider trüben zahlreiche Mängel den Aufenthalt: Check-in verspätet (15 statt 14 Uhr), Flecken auf Bett und Sonnenliegen, Regendusche funktionierte nicht richtig, Backofen nicht nutzbar, Poolpumpe musste manuell aktiviert werden, Wasserspender hygienisch fragwürdig, Kühlschrank verschmutzt. Im Hauptbad oben kam es zu Überflutungen, es gibt kein Fenster, nur eine offene Aussparung, dadurch extrem warm. Haus wirkt renovierungsbedürftig, Außenholzboden veraltet mit Löchern und Nägeln (Verletzungsgefahr). Die Villa liegt mitten in einem Resort, Ankunft war verwirrend, Manager wenig motiviert. Vor dem Resort keine Grab-/Taxi-Abfahrt erlaubt. Kaffeekapseln (10/Tag) für die ganze Gruppe zu wenig. Reinigungspersonal freundlich, musste aber laut Vorgabe 3 Stunden bleiben. Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis passt leider nicht, können die Villa nicht empfehlen.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Domenic, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re pleased to hear you enjoyed the magnificent views, private beach access, and the convenience of having the resort and restaurant nearby.
Just to clarify, the standard check-in time is 2 PM. As you arrived earlier, the villa was still being prepared. Luggage can be dropped off from 12 PM, but the villa may not yet be ready as the housekeeping team needs sufficient time to prepare it properly.
Regarding the other concerns mentioned, unfortunately, none were raised during your stay. Had they been brought to our attention, the team would have been happy to check and assist where possible. Following your feedback, the items mentioned have been checked and are currently in good condition.
As the villa is located within a resort, certain resort-wide policies apply, including arrangements for online transportation and guest pick-ups, which we kindly ask guests to respect. The villa also provides 10 coffee pods per day for up to 10 guests; this is the standard daily provision and is not unlimited.
Thank you again for your feedback. We’ll continue to maintain the villa carefully and work to provide a good quality experience for our guests.

reviews.name: Leilana
reviews.comment:
Not what we expected. Yes, the views were amazing, but there was quite a bit of confusion with everything else. 
This house is located on another resort, Biu Biu, which is not clearly disclosed when booking. This makes it convenient if you want to eat at the restaurant (no other restaurants are close by), but that is the extent because Biu Biu won’t help you. I had conflicting information regarding using their shuttle bus to the beach - we were informed we could not use it, but another person at a sister property told us we could use it. 
The upstairs master has open windows (no glass), so it’s constantly warm and you need to keep the doors close if you want the a/c to work.
The hot water was inconsistent at best with a max of 5 minutes before going cold. 
The people who managed the property were nice but only responsive during certain hours of the day, which makes it difficult if something came up in the evening. 
Not worth the money. We would not stay here again.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Leilana, we’re sorry to hear that your stay did not fully meet your expectations. While guests may enjoy the convenience of the nearby restaurant and beachfront surroundings, we would like to clarify that the villa is independently managed and is not operated by Biu Biu. Therefore, their services, facilities, and access policies may differ from those of the villa. All available facilities and services included with your stay are communicated by our team, and we kindly recommend referring to the information provided by our team, as policies at other properties may not apply to our villa.
The upstairs master bedroom is also shown clearly in the listing photos. As with any air-conditioned room, especially in a tropical climate, keeping doors and windows closed while using the air conditioning is necessary to maintain a comfortable temperature. Regarding the hot water, our team inspected the system and confirmed that it was functioning properly during the stay. We would have been happy to investigate further had we been informed of any issues while you were at the villa.
Regarding communication, during nighttime hours, responses may occasionally take longer, but our contact number and Airbnb messaging remain available, and we always do our best to respond as quickly as possible whenever assistance is needed.
Thank you again for sharing your feedback. We value guest comments as they help us continue improving our service. At the same time, we kindly encourage guests to review the villa details, facilities, and tropical setting carefully before booking to ensure expectations are aligned with the experience we provide. Thank you.

reviews.name: Johannes
reviews.comment:
This villa is not recommended. When checking in, the staff immediately hurried home without clearly explaining the details of the area.
When check-out was at 11 o'clock, the staff hadn't come by 10:40, so we took our suitcases to the front ourselves because we were going to the airport.
There are only 2 hairdryers for the expensive price of the 5-room villa.
Super slow Internet
There's no TV. 
I've never left a bad review for any villa, but this one is really not worth the price. Highly not recommended. Don't regret it!
reviews.originalComment:
Villa ini tidak recommend. Staff ketika check in langsung buru buru pulang tanpa menjelaskan detail area dengan jelas.
Ketika check out jam 11, staff sampe 10.40 juga belum ada datang, sehingga kita angkat koper sendiri kedepan karena mau ke bandara.
Hairdryer cuma ada 2 untuk harga villa yang mahal dengan tipe 5 kamar.
Internet super lambat
Ga da tv.
Saya tidak pernah meninggalkan review jelek di villa mana pun, tapi yang ini sangat tidak sesuai harganya. Sangat tidak recommend. Jangan nyesal!
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Mr. Johannes,
Thank you for taking the time to review. We are sorry that your stay did not meet your expectations.
We also apologize for any inconvenience you experienced during the check-in or check-out process. We have recorded your feedback and will follow up with the relevant team so that our service can be better in the future.

Hi Karmorreya, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. Regarding directions, apps such as Grab may not always accurately show newer or private villa locations, but we are always happy to assist with directions or arrange transport when required.
The villa is situated within a villa complex in Bali and is surrounded by a natural Balinese environment, which is part of the authentic local experience. All important details are clearly communicated before arrival and we remain available throughout each stay for any support needed.
While we always welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement, we also hope that everyone visiting Bali takes the time to appreciate the island’s unique culture, natural surroundings, and local way of life, while respecting that the experience here may be different from what they are accustomed to elsewhere.
